name: Cupriferous-Scree
description: Bare rock from pole to pole, shaded in grays, ox-blood reds, and pale magnesium white. The regolith records four billion years of bombardment, scarred through by dust seas stretching to the horizon near the terminator.
The air carries ozone and crushed stone, and sound behaves strangely: footsteps crack loud, then die without echo. At night the temperature drops fast enough to hear the rock tick as it contracts.
Nothing about the exotic matter deposit appears on any natural-phenomena registry. The leading research institutions classify it as 'pending,' which is science's word for afraid.
Every syndicate scout files the same advice: harvest fast, land light, and never spend a full cycle planetside. The wise ones follow it exactly once.
